intro.p1: You have <l1>{{minutes}} minutes</l1> total to complete both challenges. Starting Challenge 1 unlocks Challenge 2 — work them in any order, and switch between them at will. When the timer hits zero, submissions lock and you'll be taken to your results.
intro.p2: Every answer lives inside the Salt platform. Open it in another tab, hunt through the UI, submit each flag here. Wrong guesses add <l1>+15 seconds</l1> each, so take the time to get it right.
intro.p3: <l1>Answers with multiple values:</l1> separate each with a comma + space. Order doesn't matter — `A, B` and `B, A` both land. Answers are case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant.
intro.errorStart: Couldn't start the timer. Refresh and try again.

error.notBegun: Couldn't submit. Refresh and try again.

workshop.label: Standby
workshop.body: Your admin will open the challenge shortly. Sit tight, keep this tab open. When the gate lifts, you'll see the Begin button — and the 35-minute clock starts the moment you click.

nexus.label: Standby
nexus.body: Nexus unlocks once the challenge phase wraps up. Your admin will release it when the 35-minute timer ends, stay in this tab and we'll route you to the live attack simulation the moment it opens.

step1.label: Step 01
step1.heading: Launch the Salt Platform
step1.body: Open the Salt platform in a new tab, submit each flag here as you find it. <l1>Launch Salt Platform →</l1>

step2.label: Step 02
step2.heading: How to find the answers
step2.body: Every question above maps to a screen Scenario 1 walked you through, the inventory dashboard, the agentic graph, the MCP and tool side-drawers, and the sortable capabilities table.

step3.label: Step 03
step3.heading: The Agentic UI
step3.body: Salt surfaces every MCP server an agent touches, in a single agentic security view. On this page you'll find the MCP servers Salt identified in your environment, discovered from live traffic or pulled from connectors like AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Azure Foundry, GitHub, and Databricks, with relevant details for each, and filters to isolate the specific capabilities of every connected tool.

step4.label: Step 04
step4.heading: The Agentic Security Graph
step4.body: The Graph view gives you a comprehensive read of each agent and MCP server, their respective tools and capabilities, and the technologies and applications behind each. You'll also find an insight layer to overlay risk, posture gaps, and sensitive data exposure.

step5.label: Step 05
step5.heading: The Discovery Inventory
step5.body: The inventory dashboard is the high-level count of everything Salt finds across your API landscape. This includes each specific host, its respective APIs, and any MCP-related findings. Use the resources we just went over to answer the questions above. Happy hunting!

registration.heading: Enter the Arena
registration.body: Your name and email lock you to this session. One registration per email, no second chances, no do-overs.
